a.subject: Professor Emily Chen
reviews: Professor Chen knows the material really well and she is happy to help in office hours.
Exams are much harder than the homework, and her grading is strict.
Chen explains concepts clearly, but the pace is fast.
I learned a lot from her, though the exams were brutal.

a.subject: Professor Jamal Washington
reviews: Washington is the most organized professor I've had. His lectures are clear.
Always answers questions and he gives detailed feedback on every paper.
Fair grading and he genuinely cares whether you learn.
Would take him again for any class.
